title: bonsai.lock/1
description: The lock (contract §14, spec §6): exactly which pack versions and files a workspace holds, so an update writes everything or nothing and an edit is never overwritten. Lives in the project at .bonsai/lock.json, committed, person-only. Written by Bonsai's engine (init, update); read by the engine, bonsai check (in CI, with no pack fetched), verifiers and people reading a diff; the studio reads it only through status --json. Keys sorted, forward slashes only, no absolute path anywhere. A writer writes every field below, in this order (contract §2.2); a reader treats a missing field as null, keeps an unknown one and refuses a duplicate key.

format.description: The version, always the first field (contract §2.2).

written_by.description: The version of the Bonsai that wrote the lock.

packs.description: Each pack in bonsai.yaml's order: its source, version, resolved commit, content hash, and what it declares.

source.description: Where the pack is fetched from (a git URL).

version.description: The pack's version, from the tag bonsai.yaml names.

commit.description: The tag's resolved 40-character commit (spec §5); a tag that later resolves elsewhere is refused.

sha256.description: The pack's content hash, SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex characters.

declares.description: What the pack declared at the locked commit, copied in so bonsai check runs in CI with no pack fetched (spec §6, §16 row 18): its lanes, document kinds, label definitions and protected paths. The four kinds are fixed; their key names and inner layout are not, so it is typed open (formats/README.md). {} for a pack that declares nothing.

files.description: Every file Bonsai wrote, by project-relative path (forward slashes, keys sorted): its kind, the pack it came from, and the SHA-256 of its bytes with line endings made LF.

kind.description: How the engine treats the file (contract §14, spec §6), a closed list: pack (Bonsai's; an edit is a conflict), once (written once, then the project's), block (a marked region in a project-owned file), keys (Bonsai's own entries in a project-owned JSON file), kept (a pack file the person kept edited).

pack.description: The id of the pack the file came from.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of what Bonsai last wrote, line endings made LF, 64 lowercase hex characters.

format0.description: Every Bonsai-kind file without a format: line at link time (contract §2.3), by project-relative path, with the SHA-256 of its bytes after every line ending is made LF; {} when none. Such a file must stay on this list with this hash.
